consequence.statement: Monitoring systems scraping the `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` metric will receive an additional `return_code` label on each metric series, which may require updating metric queries and dashboards.

assertion.statement: The `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` metric now includes a `return_code` label to specify the HTTP code of the request.
